option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological features match the characteristics of Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC).
Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma is a type of basal cell carcinoma that can be associated with Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC).
Basal cell nevus syndrome (Gorlin syndrome) is a distinct genetic disorder that is not directly related to the clinical presentation and histopathological features described.

Gorlin Syndrome (Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome) is another name for Basal cell nevus syndrome, which is a distinct genetic disorder that is not directly related to the clinical presentation and histopathological features described.
